blb.text: Hugs was a nameless, mute badgerfolk who fended off a Calamity Beast while Gev led a town to safety, and the children hugged him, so Gev named him.
Hugs volunteered to accompany Mabel to investigate Pondside, and Gev joined to keep an eye on him, along with Finneas, Zoraline and Helga.
At the ruins of Pondside, Hugs and Mabel read tracks showing the villagers went south toward Haymeadow, and the party fought skeletons raised by necromancers.
When the Flood Gar attacked Three Tree City, Hugs kept everyone afloat in the Long River, and he was instrumental in saving the party.
